provenance: Transcribed from Chapter 4 of Xincheng Li's dissertation, Adaptive Context Modelling and Detail-Guided Reconstruction for Retinal Vessel Segmentation.
indomain_and_ablation_units: SE, SP, ACC, F1, AUC and mIoU are fractions. HD95_mean and HD95_sd give the reported boundary-distance mean and standard deviation; the distance unit was not recorded.
metric_aggregation: SE, SP, ACC, F1 and AUC are unweighted image-wise means. The archived summaries do not specify the mIoU class set or the HD95 directional convention.
transfer_delta_units: Signed percentage points in *_delta_pp columns of paper_transfer.csv. Each delta equals the source-trained score minus the target-trained score on the same target images, with a fixed threshold of 0.5 for binary predictions.

protocol_result_link_status.STARE: Author confirmed all existing STARE experiments used 10/10; earlier five-fold text was a writing error, not a change of experiment.

statistics.table_7: Historical manuscript only. Its Table 7 reports AUC means and standard deviations and Wilcoxon rank-sum comparisons with CGDD-Net. The dissertation tables listed here contain no p-values.
statistics.observation_unit: one complete test image's AUC, calculated after patch probability reconstruction
statistics.dispersion: between-image standard deviation, not variability across training seeds
statistics.sample_size_bounds: scripts/exact_p_bounds.py reports conditional mathematical minima, not empirical p-values or significance.

complexity.common_comparison_setup: In dissertation Table 4.16, GDF-Net, MPS-Net and WA-Net were profiled with matched input shape and analysis tool. CGDD-Net's reported 29.96 GFLOPs comes from a separate record.
complexity.batch_64_by_64_by_64_hypothesis: not established by U-Net's reported 50.11 GFLOPs; explicit profiler input does not recover the original measurement

table_sources.paper_results.csv: Dissertation Table 4.4, complete CGDD-Net on four datasets.
table_sources.paper_comparisons.csv: Dissertation Tables 4.5–4.8. ACC, SE, SP, F1, mIoU and AUC are fractions. HD95 contains the reported distance, and HD95_sd contains its standard deviation where available. Empty cells denote values not reported in the tables. score_source and source_table identify the source of each set of scores.
table_sources.paper_ablation.csv: Dissertation Tables 4.9–4.12, seven cumulative configurations per dataset.
table_sources.paper_ablation_gains.csv: Dissertation Table 4.13. Each delta is 100 times the difference between the full and baseline configurations in paper_ablation.csv, in percentage points.
table_sources.paper_transfer.csv: Dissertation Table 4.14, absolute target scores and five signed changes for each of twelve source-to-target directions.
table_sources.paper_sensitivity.csv: Dissertation Table 4.15. CHASE_DB1 accuracy (fraction) as dropout, patch batch size or learning rate varies. The default configuration appears in each sweep. The archived experiment records omit the validation split and checkpoint-selection rule.
table_sources.paper_complexity.csv: Dissertation Table 4.16. AUC and F1 are percentages, parameters are in millions and FLOPs are in billions. score_source and cost_source apply separately. 'unspecified' means the cited study did not identify the test dataset for that score.

score_and_cost_references.AttUKAN: S. Zeng et al., Novel extraction of discriminative fine-grained feature to improve retinal vessel segmentation. Tables 2 (DRIVE), 4 (CHASE_DB1), 3 (STARE) and 5 (HRF). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.imavis.2025.105729
score_and_cost_references.DSAE-Net: Z. Zeng et al., Efficient Retinal Vessel Segmentation with 78K Parameters. Table 3. https://doi.org/10.3390/jimaging11090306
M. Ma, L. Liang and X. Sheng, MDF-Net: An Attention-Guided Multi-Scale Dual-Fusion Network for Retinal Vessel Segmentation. Tables 5 and 10. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.measurement.2025.118695
Z. Ye et al., A High-Resolution Network with Strip Attention for Retinal Vessel Segmentation. Table 6. https://doi.org/10.3390/s23218899
